on your touch-tone phone. Please note that this conference is being recorded.

Limited. Over to you, sir. 
Naveen Agarwal: 
Good evening, everyone. Welcome to ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company 
Limited's earning call for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. I trust you had the 
opportunity to review our earnings presentation and the investor's materials, which have 
been shared on the stock exchange and our website. 
I'll start with the overview of the mutual fund industry. The industry's quarterly average AUM 
grew by 13.4% year-on-year and 5.1% sequentially in Q2 FY 2027, reaching to INR87.49 
lakh crores. 
Equity and equity-oriented quarterly average AUM stood at INR48.19 lakh crores, reflecting 
a year-on-year growth of 15.3%. This growth reflects the continued broader trend of 
financialization of household savings despite periods of volatility driven by global rate 
movements, crude oil prices, geopolitical tensions, and even subdued market performance 
in the last two years. 
In the first half of the fiscal year, the NIFTY 50 delivered 1.3% return compared to Midcap of 
12.5% and Smallcap at 24.6%. During this quarter, net flows for the equity categories were 
INR1.06 lakh crores, which marked an approximate 7% reduction as compared to previous 
quarter. 
September 2026 recorded SIP contribution of INR32,490 crores. Monthly SIP inflows 
remained largely stable throughout Q2 FY 2027. Debt segment continue to face marginal 
reduction in quarterly average AUM at INR11.60 lakh crores. 
Passive quarterly average AUM grew by 23% year-on-year and 3.1% sequentially to 
INR15.19 lakh crores. Industry continued to have positive new customer addition, reaching 
a count of 6.3 crores, which represents an increase of 11.1% year-on-year. I now hand over 
the call to Harshil for covering the performance of our company. 

 
3 
 
Harshil Sanghvi: 
Thank you, Naveen. Good evening, everyone. For the quarter ended September 2026, our 
total mutual fund quarterly average AUM reached to INR11.61 lakh crores, which is up 
14.4% year-on-year, thereby maintaining our position as the second largest AMC with a 
market share of 13.3%. 
In active schemes, we continue to maintain the highest market share of 13.3% with a 
quarterly average AUM of INR9.59 lakh crores. As of September 30, 2026, we continue to 
maintain our leadership position in equity and equity-oriented schemes with a market share 
of 13.7% and a quarterly average AUM of INR6.59 lakh crores. 
On year-on-year basis, we grew by 16.3%, thereby outperforming the industry growth rate. 
It is important to note that in H1 FY 2027, we continue to receive one of the highest net flows 
amongst the industry. 
The quarterly average AUM of our equity-oriented hybrid schemes grew to INR2.29 lakh 
crores. This represents the largest market share of 26.4% as of September 30, 2026. For H1 
FY 2027, our margins on an annualized basis stands at 67 basis points for equity, 32 basis 
points for debt, 12 basis points for liquid, 12 basis points for passives, and 29 basis points 
for arbitrage. 
As of September 30, 2026, we have a unique customer base of 1.78 crores. In September 
30, 2026, our systematic transactions, which includes SIPs and systematic transfer plans, 
stood at INR4,672 crores. 
Our distribution mix of our mutual fund equity quarterly average AUM is as follows, where 
MFDs accounts for 36.1%, National Distributors accounts for 15.9%, ICICI Bank share at 
7.5%, other bank contributing 10.6%, and direct representing 29.9%. 
On SIF, we continue to see good traction, leading to a quarterly average AUM of INR4,948 
crores in Q2 FY 2027 versus INR2,678 crores in Q1 FY 2027. In this quarter, we launched 
NFOs of Balanced Hybrid Funds, Multi Asset Active Fund of Fund, Dynamic Asset Allocation 
Passive Fund of Fund, BSE Insurance ETF, and three Life Cycle Funds with maturity of 5, 10, 
and 15 years, thereby further expanding our product bouquet. 
Now let's move to our alternates business, which comprise listed equity-focused PMS and 
AIF, private credit, real estate, private equity, early stage private equity, and offshore 
advisory. For the September quarter end, our alternate quarterly average AUM stood at 
INR80,965 crores. Within alternates, our PMS quarterly average AUM grew by 21.4% year-
on-year to INR30,791 crores. Our AIF quarterly average AUM stands at INR24,260 crores. 
During the quarter, the board of the company had approved acquisition of PMS business 
from ICICI Securities Limited. Integrating the PMS business of ICICI Securities will enable the 
company to engage with incremental new clients and also certain product offerings 
proposed to be acquired as a part of this transactions are complimentary to the company's 

 
4 
 
current PMS offerings. We are in a process of obtaining requisite approvals and completion 
of necessary documents.

1.92%, and the net yield, that is after reducing the fees and commission expenses 
attributable to PMS and AIF business, was at 0.96%. Yields on assets under advisory was 
at 0.32%. 
I now hand over the call to Naveen for covering the financial performance of the company. 
Naveen Agarwal: 
Let's cover the financial performance for the quarter and yields, which are presented on 
annualized basis. Just to clarify, as you all are aware, comparative data has been restated 
by considering the effect of the acquired business of specific funds from ICICI Venture. 
Our operating revenue stood at INR1,674 crores, representing a growth of 16.3% year-on-
year and 7% sequentially. For quarter ended, our operating net revenue mix from mutual 
fund was 89.91%, alternates 8.68%, and advisory business 1.42%. 
Other income of INR16.9 crores reduced when compared to previous quarter, primarily due 
to mark-to-market. Operating expenses amounted to INR493 crores, which was an increase 
by 17.9% year-on-year and 6.2% quarter-on-quarter. 
Our operating profit before tax, which indicates the core profitability of the business, 
reached INR1,181 crores. This represents a 15.7% increase year-on-year and a growth of 
7.4% compared to the previous quarter. 
Profit after tax stood at INR889 crores, which is up by 6.1% year-on-year and had a 
degrowth of 7.8% quarter-on-quarter, primarily, as explained earlier, due to other income. 
Additionally, the Board of Directors has declared an interim dividend of INR30 per share. 
For H1 FY27, our gross yield and net yield on an annualized basis stood at 53 basis point 
and 48.8 basis point, respectively. Net yield is arrived at after reducing fees and commission 
expenses on PMS and AIF businesses, which is shown as an expense item in the P&L. For 
H1 FY27, our operating margins on an annualized basis stood at 37.3 basis point as 
compared to 36.6 basis point for H1 of FY26.

and addressing any queries you may have.

continue to explore, and at appropriate time, we would we would consider launching them.
